BreezeHill_Text_Npc0.fr: TARSAL est timide. Sois patient et\nchanceux.
BreezeHill_Text_Npc0.en: RALTS is shy. Be patient and be\nlucky.

BreezeHill_Text_Npc1.fr: Le vent d'ici attire les petits\nPOKéMON.
BreezeHill_Text_Npc1.en: The wind here carries every early\nPOKéMON to you.

BreezeHill_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

BreezeHill_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
BreezeHill_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
